deviations: Meridian's busiest pod by scene-event count is Convoy Planning Pod, as expected.
Pod labels are the path tail ('Comet Pod', 'Harbor Pod'), not bare names.
waits adds carryBeats (beats with carry > 0) beside carryMs (sum over beats); carryMs is 0 for every pod at 1x.

Frame components are rounded to integer ms and tailGapMs takes the rounding remainder, so sums are exact; playingMs is likewise beatsMs minus held, so the rule rows can differ from playingMs by a few ms.
byRule rows also carry per-phase ms and the maneuver count; byPhase keys include 'hold'.
limitations: Ledger reflects the working tree on top of start commit 75fb4a7 at the moment of the last regeneration; B4 had uncommitted src/ edits in the tree (src/shared/scene/project/solar.ts etc. were already modified at start). If B4's changes move schedule numbers, rerun npm run pacing.
Waiting causes are inferred from the plan (P-5/P-3/P-4/P-6/other), labelled as such; the engine's queue is private.
Held time is ~0 for every pod (beats are sized to their maneuvers); Harbor shows 0.2 s.
Budget (45 s) only cuts accented beats, so totals far exceed 45 s on the busy pods (Quasar 1080 s, Pulsar 702 s).
